messages:
sam: Holding the change window — integration CI is failing at the artifact finalize step, deploy-bot is stuck in retry loop.

yara: Ugh. Any logs from the uploader?

sam: Pasting the tail from bk-agent-18 (04:37 UTC):
```
[artifact/uploader] finalize multipart: write returned error: unexpected EOF
WARN 2026-03-23T04:37:11Z retrying finalize (attempt=3)
ERROR 2026-03-23T04:37:15Z finalize aborted: Unexpected EOF while writing last part
```

miguel: Ops-bot, any runner GC or eviction events around then?

ops-bot: MONITOR: eu-west-runner-pool GC spike detected at 04:35 UTC. Ephemeral volume evictions: 7.

yara: That correlates. Looks like uploads are getting interrupted when runner ephemeral volumes are reclaimed mid-stream.

sam: If we wait and retry we risk missing the change window. Options: 1) wait and hope the next CI run succeeds, 2) pin the last-known-good artifact and manual-promote to preserve the window, 3) abort the window and postpone release.

miguel: For velocity, pin+promote. We can add a release-note explaining the pin and follow up with infra to harden uploader.

yara: Agreed. What's the last-good digest?

sam: Last promoted artifact is commit 1785440000 — image sha256:3a7f9c2b0d4e. I can manual-promote if we have approvals.

deploy-bot: MANUAL PROMOTE ACTION: run `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1785440000 --reason "CI artifact finalize EOF; preserve change window"` (requires approver or --override).

miguel: I'll approve. Also, can we temporarily disable the aggressive GC cleanup in eu-west for the next 30m to reduce flakiness?

ops-bot: CONFIG: aggressive-ephemeral-gc in eu-west paused for 30m by @miguel.

sam: Running manual-promote now: `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1785440000 --author @sam`

bk-bot: PROMOTE: canary rollout started for release 2026.03.23-pin-hotfix (pinned sha256:3a7f9c2b0d4e).

deploy-bot: PROMOTE SUCCESS: canary deployed and all sanity checks passed (11/11). Monitoring window: 15m.

yara: Draft release note: "Hotfix: pinned to last-known-good artifact (sha256:3a7f9c2b0d4e) due to intermittent artifact finalize EOFs during CI uploads; infra follow-up opened (infra#4801)."

sam: Opening infra#4801: "Multipart finalize EOFs when runner ephemeral volumes evicted mid-upload; add stronger finalize retry logic and consider smaller final-chunk sizes." Assigning to @infra-team.

miguel: After the window we'll revert the GC setting and prioritize a small uploader patch: add robust retry on finalize and exponential backoff.

sam: Keeping the change window open. If canary metrics degrade I'll call rollback. Thanks all :thumbsup:
